tools.name: serviceminder_locate_contacts
tools.description: Find contacts by name, phone, email, address, contact ID, tag or category. Needs a brand-scoped API key. Calls POST /api/contacts/locate.

tools.name: serviceminder_query_appointments
tools.description: List appointments by date range, last change, contact or service agent. Pages with skip and take (max 500). Calls POST /api/appointments/query.

tools.name: serviceminder_query_proposals
tools.description: List proposals by scope, date, acceptance date, owner or contact. The public docs do not list scope values, so pass the scope name your account uses. Calls POST /api/proposal/query.

tools.name: serviceminder_get_proposal
tools.description: Get one proposal with its lines, status, totals and customer notes. Calls POST /api/proposal/details.

tools.name: serviceminder_query_invoices
tools.description: List invoices by date range, last change or contact. Pages with skip and take (max 500). Calls POST /api/invoice/query.

tools.name: serviceminder_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice with its payments. Calls POST /api/invoice/get.

tools.name: serviceminder_query_payments
tools.description: List payments by date range, contact or invoice. Pages with skip and take (max 500). Calls POST /api/payment/query.

tools.name: serviceminder_list_services
tools.description: List the services of the organization, optionally with parts. Calls POST /api/services/all.

tools.name: serviceminder_list_service_agents
tools.description: List the service agents (field staff) of the organization. Calls POST /api/serviceagents/all.

tools.name: serviceminder_get_organization
tools.description: Get the details of an organization: its services, agents, users and custom fields. Calls POST /api/organizations/details.

tools.name: serviceminder_query_tasks
tools.description: List follow-up tasks by due date, last change, contact or type. Pages with skip and take. Calls POST /api/task/query.

tools.name: serviceminder_add_or_update_contact
tools.description: Add a lead or update a contact. Needs a name and a phone or an email. Custom fields use the names in your account. Calls POST /api/contacts/addupdate.

tools.name: serviceminder_add_contact_note
tools.description: Add a note to a contact. Calls POST /api/contacts/addnote.

tools.name: serviceminder_create_task
tools.description: Create a follow-up task for a contact. Calls POST /api/task/create.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: serviceminder_query_appointments, serviceminder_query_proposals, serviceminder_get_proposal, serviceminder_query_invoices, serviceminder_get_invoice, serviceminder_query_payments, serviceminder_list_services, serviceminder_list_service_agents, serviceminder_get_organization, serviceminder_query_tasks · Private data: serviceminder_locate_contacts, serviceminder_query_appointments, serviceminder_query_proposals, serviceminder_query_invoices, serviceminder_query_payments, serviceminder_query_tasks, serviceminder_add_or_update_contact, serviceminder_add_contact_note, serviceminder_create_task · Public sink: serviceminder_locate_contacts, serviceminder_query_appointments, serviceminder_query_proposals, serviceminder_get_proposal, serviceminder_query_invoices, serviceminder_get_invoice, serviceminder_query_payments, serviceminder_list_services, serviceminder_list_service_agents, serviceminder_get_organization, serviceminder_query_tasks, serviceminder_add_or_update_contact, serviceminder_add_contact_note, serviceminder_create_task.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
